subject: Contract-markup & joint demo coordination — backup slots + prep
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@acmehealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint session: demo + contract-markup (proposed slots)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time last week. To keep momentum toward the pilot, we want to run a combined session to:

- Walk through the technical demo (SE-led, 20 minutes)
- Review the SOW and marked-up contract points (legal + procurement, 25 minutes)
- Agree on next steps for signature and onboarding (10 minutes)

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Wed 22 Jul | 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 23 Jul | 08:00–09:00 PT (early option for APAC folks)
- Fri 24 Jul | 13:00–14:00 PT

Attached: ACME_Master_SOW_v3.pdf and a Redline_Template_ACME.docx for consolidated changes — please put all redline comments into the template so Marissa can triage.

Agenda is lightweight; main ask is: who from your side needs to attend for legal/procurement/security sign-off? I’ve copied procurement for visibility.

If those times don’t work, we can provide a recorded demo and schedule a legal-only redline call.

Thanks — 
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: ACME_Master_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Redline_Template_ACME.docx (docx)]
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@acmehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, Samir Raj <sraj@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint session: demo + contract-markup (proposed slots)

Vanessa —

Appreciate the clear agenda. Procurement and security will need to be on the review; I’ve looped them in. Procurement prefers Fri but they have a standing review on Thursday mornings. Security (Samir) is available on Wed afternoon / Thu morning. My team (platform engineering) can make Wed 22 Jul 10:00 PT work if that’s the consensus.

I’ve attached our procurement checklist for context — it highlights a few items we’ll prioritize (data residency language, liability caps, and logging/audit expectations).

If we lock Wed 22 at 10:00 PT, please confirm dial-in and who will present the contract changes so we can prepare internal SMEs.

Thanks,
Alex Porter
Director, Platform Engineering — Acme Health
alex.porter@acmehealth.com
[Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@acmehealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint session: demo + contract-markup (proposed slots)

Thanks Alex — Wed 22 Jul 10:00 PT works for our side.

A few quick operational points so the meeting is productive:
- Please consolidate your marked clauses into Redline_Template_ACME.docx and upload to the shared Drive link before 8:00 AM PT on Wed. Marissa will triage and flag anything that needs leadership escalation.
- Primary goals: confirm pilot scope, agree on liability/term language, and align on onboarding steps.
- Tech demo will be ~20 minutes (Dylan will run an end-to-end runbook plus a short live query test).

Attachments & invite: Joint-Redline-Session.ics included — I’ll send the calendar invite and a short pre-read (one pager) this afternoon. If legal cannot make it at the last minute, plan B: we run the demo, record it, and set a follow-up legal-only session the same week.

Logistics for the call: Zoom link (will be in the invite), dial-in + recording — let me know if you need a company-specific NDAtag on the recording.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Soojin Lee
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
[Invitation: Joint-Redline-Session.ics (ics)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint session: demo + contract-markup (proposed slots)

I can join Wed 22 Jul 10:00 PT for the redline portion. A few asks from legal: please ensure we receive a single consolidated document with tracked changes (the Redline_Template_ACME.docx is preferred). If there are multiple PDFs with annotations we’ll request they be merged.

Also: flag any non-standard escrow or third-party subprocessors in the pre-read so I can escalate to Vivek if necessary. Post-call, I’ll prepare a short summary of required changes plus a recommended sign-off path (DocuSign or countersign).

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
